_readme: Copy to ~/.werkel/werkel.config.json (global) or <repo>/.werkel.json (per project). All prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

budget._comment: The guard every delegation passes. Lower the two ceilings to make werkel cheaper; raise maxDailyUsd carefully.

_profiles_hint: `werkel suggest --write` regenerates these from the providers you are authenticated for.

free.description: Free models — bulk work at zero cost

balanced.description: Default worker: features, bug fixes, medium refactors

strong.description: Tricky logic, cross-file changes, unclear bugs

longcontext.description: Jobs that must read a lot at once (1M+ context)

local.description: Free local models — configure the provider in opencode first

staticPricing._comment: Overrides only. Prices normally come from models.dev (all providers opencode knows) and the live OpenRouter catalogue. An entry here wins over both.
